title: UI explainer reel

provenance.note: Measured from 1 reference video (public-statistics). Only statistics are stored; coverage is estimated from pixels. With one reference, p50 is its value and p10 and p90 are set 15% either side so the gate holds a band, not an exact match. Left out: face_time, text_hold_seconds, shot_seconds. One public faceless explainer reel (9:16, 46 s) that walks through software tools on dark animated interface panels with a small sprite host. face_time is left out because the face probe reads the sprite host as a presenter; text_hold_seconds because the designed-region estimate sees the whole interface as one graphic. shot_seconds is left out because the reference changes scene with whip-pans and wipes, which the cut detector does not see, so it measured one 46 s shot. first_motion_seconds p90 is 0.35 s, not the reference's 0: the reference opens mid-move, while a reel that opens on a built frame needs a fraction of a second before whole-frame motion registers.

description: A faceless explainer reel for Reels, Shorts and TikTok, 30–75 s in 9:16, that shows software tools and workflows on dark animated interface panels: timelines, meters, terminals and cards that build and change on the words.
